# Support matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_support_matrix.py from CI's files and tests/hk/ir/engine_facts/. Do not edit; the IR tier fails when it is stale. -->

What this checkout of hk-dsl (version 0.9.7, and main's changes after it) is tested with. A version that is not here may work, but nothing tests it. 0.8.0 had no such page: for it, see docs/install.md and docs/toolchains.md at the v0.8.0 tag.

## hk's own tests

Every pull request runs the no-GPU tiers, and the GPU tier on each arch before it merges ([testing](testing.md)).

| arch | GPU | image | ROCm | Python | torch |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| gfx1100 | Radeon PRO W7900 | `rocm/pytorch:rocm7.2.4_ubuntu24.04_py3.12_pytorch_release_2.10.0` | 7.2.4 | 3.12 | 2.10.0 |
| gfx1201 | Radeon AI PRO R9700 | `rocm/pytorch:rocm7.2.3_ubuntu24.04_py3.12_pytorch_release_2.10.0` | 7.2.3 | 3.12 | 2.10.0 |
| gfx950 | Instinct MI355X | `rocm/pytorch:rocm7.2.3_ubuntu24.04_py3.12_pytorch_release_2.10.0` | 7.2.3 | 3.12 | 2.10.0 |
| none | -- | Ubuntu 22.04, hipcc from ROCm 7.1 (the IR and codegen tiers, the wheel) | 7.1 | 3.10 | -- |

gfx950 has a second GPU tier, gfx950-vllm: the gfx950 routes' tests and their engine contract, in the vLLM image they were measured on (`vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-rocm100-e68efc685ab1e6f1eda004ced7157e3ca411da2f`, below).

`pip install hk-dsl` needs Python 3.10 or newer; torch is optional, and needed only to call kernels with torch tensors or to use [`hk.torch_op`](runtime.md#torch-ops-and-the-sdpa-drop-in).

## Serving engines

Each row is an image whose engines' contract facts are recorded in `tests/hk/ir/engine_facts/`. The IR tier holds every route that is on by default on that arch to them ([integration](integration.md#supported-versions-and-the-contract-tests)). A route whose contract an image breaks is off there, with a warning, and the others stay on; it is shown struck through, with the reason.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| vLLM ROCm nightly e68efc685 | measured | vllm 0.32.1rc1.dev36+ge68efc685.rocm100 | 10.0 | 2.12.0+rocm10.0.0 | triton 3.8.0+git669b31ac | 3.12.15 | `vllm_mxfp8`, `vllm_moe_a8w4`, `vllm_dsv41_index`, `vllm_sparse_mla`, `vllm_int4` |

Roles: **production**, an image hk serves in; **measured**, the engine version hk's routes were measured on, end to end; **development**, the newest image on this arch; no production image yet.

To add an image, record it inside the image and commit the file ([testing](testing.md)), then run `python3 scripts/gen_support_matrix.py`.
